doc.title: Rebecca Kilgore interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 13, 1997

title: Opening of the interview at Chautauqua
summary: Monk Rowe greets Kilgore on camera and jokes about asking her to sing.

story.theme_name: Opening the interview: Monk Rowe's welcome and archive boilerplate
story.community_name: Opening the Hamilton College interview: introductions and boilerplate

blocks.x: We’re interviewing today in Chautauqua, New York and it’s a great pleasure for me to have vocalist and guitarist Rebecca Kilgore joining us. Pleased to meet you — in front of the cameras.
Good to meet you in front of the cameras too.
So what did you want to sing for us today?
I don’t want to sing anything.
